title: 潮汐力の書架と、事象の地平の灯火
author: 七海 シグマ

en.title: The Tidal Force Library and the Light of the Event Horizon
en.premise: In an era where cosmic radiation accelerates the decay of digital data, humanity has returned to analog physical media to preserve its knowledge. Leon, a record restorationist, hunts for fragments of lost civilizations in the "Sleepless City," a place where the concept of night has vanished, bathed in the intense radiance of a black hole's accretion disk. Within a second-hand bookstore located in a special sector designed to block gravitational interference, he discovers an ancient tome containing contradictions of causality. It is a blueprint of the universe, inscribed with forbidden formulas meant to halt the thermodynamic death of information.

zh.title: 潮汐力的书架与事件视界的灯火
zh.premise: 在宇宙射线导致比特腐败加速的时代，人类将信息的保存手段重新回归到了模拟物理介质。记录修复师莱昂在被黑洞吸积盘强光照亮、失去了“夜晚”概念的“不夜城”中，追寻着失落文明的碎片。在一个将重力干扰屏蔽至极限的特殊区域的“旧书店”里，他发现了一本包含因果律矛盾的古书。那是一本记载着禁忌公式、旨在阻止信息热力学之死的宇宙设计图。
